verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI Assistant accepts natural-language requests to read threads, write drafts, search email history and check the calendar, and it can reach other apps through MCP integrations. Users can also write inbox automation rules in plain English to label, star and archive mail, and the send scheduler takes natural-language times. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the chat assistant can carry out every inbox operation (e.g. archiving or sending directly from a command), independent hands-on corroboration of the natural-language assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: It’s incredibly capable: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.
Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
Shortwave's scheduler uses the power of natural language to give you maximum control over when your email gets sent.
connects our AI Assistant to all your business applications, letting you accomplish complex workflows without ever leaving your inbox.
